description: Composes a LinkedIn post from a published DevSpeak article. Requires DevSpeak administrator privileges — a standard API key receives 403. Defaults to a preview; pass dryRun:false to publish, which is irreversible.

category.description: Tutorial category. Required when contentType is 'tutorial'

contentType.description: Which published content collection the article belongs to

dryRun.description: Compose and return the post without publishing. Default true — always preview before publishing

guidance.description: Optional steer on the angle or emphasis

postText.description: Replaces the generated copy. Only honoured when dryRun is false

name: publish_linkedin_post
